full_judgment: 6. The defendant No. 3, Md Abul Hossain Mollah, subsequent purchaser from defendant No.1 contested the suit by filing separate written statement. The positive case of the defendant is that the area of land measuring '25 acres of SA Khatian No. 96 of Kalikatola Mouza belong's to defendant No. 1. Area of '26 acres under S.A. Khatian No. 14 of Bagulat Mouza, '21 acres of land from Plot No. 834, '09 acres of land from Plot No. 460, '25 acres of land from Plot No. 834 of Mouza Damdama Mouza, '25 acres of land from Plot No. 174 of Mouza Kalikatola in total 1.09 acres belongs to defendant No.1. She entered into an bainanama on 15-12-1992 for sale of the suit land for a total consideration of Taka 78,000 out of which the defendant No.3 paid Taka 50,000 as advance and delivered possession to defendant No. 3. Subsequently, defendant No.1 further received a sum of Taka 10,000 on 2-2-1993, Taka 8,000 on 3-3-1993, and Taka 7,000 on 4-4-1993 by putting her signature on the back side of the bainanama. Latter on he did not execute and register the Kabala after receiving the balance amount of Taka 3,000. The defendant No. 1 refused to register the kabala on 2-2-1994, then he filed a Title Suit No. 31 of 1994 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Kumarkhali impleading the defendant No.1 as defendant and got a decree on 22-8-1994 and after decree defendant No.1 withdraw Taka 3,000 deposited in the said suit. This defendant filed Title Execution case being No. 4 of 1994 and got a registered Kabala No.1032 dated 26-2-1995 through court and took possession on 3-12-1995. Subsequently, this defendant mutated the land through Mutation Case No. 532/9-2/94-95. The present plaintiff and one Abu Taleb Sk. filed Title Suit No. 56 of 1995 impleading present defendant as defendant No.1 and Bhabani Bala Chowdhury as defendant No.2 and prayed for a declaration that the Judgment and decree dated 22-8-1994 passed in Title Suit No. 31 of 1994 is illegal, collusive, inoperative, void and the deed is not binding upon the plaintiff. In that suit, the present defendant No.2, Bhabani Bala Chowdhury filed written statement and admits the bainanama dated 15-12-1992 and the Title Suit No. 31 of 1994 which is filed in respect of bainanama dated 15-12-1992. This defendant and Bhabani Bala Chowdhury contested in Title Suit No.56 of 1995 and the learned court was pleased to dismiss the suit on 24-6-1997. The plaintiffs have no right, title, interest in the suit land; that the land measuring 26 acres in schedule-1 and 0.58 acres of land described in scheduled-2 and the rest land have been in possession of the defendant No.1 for more than twelve years. The defendant No. 1 disclosed on 14th Magh, 1399 BS correspondence on 27-1-1993 that she did not execute any bainanama in favour of the plaintiff. That the plaintiff is aware about the bainanama executed between the defendant No. 3 and plaintiff. The plaintiff has filed this case just to harass the defendant. Hence, this defendant prays for dismissal of the suit.
